title: Privacy Policy
seoDescription: How Golden Bay Holiday Homes collects and uses booking, contact and website data, and how you can request access or correction of your personal details.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: Golden Bay Holiday Homes operates holiday home bookings and property management in Golden Bay, New Zealand. Contact: admin@gbholidayhomes.co.nz.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect contact details, booking dates, payment references, and communications needed to fulfil stays and manage properties. Analytics tools may collect anonymised usage data.

sections.heading: How we use information
sections.body: To process bookings, provide guest support, communicate with homeowners, improve our website, and meet legal obligations including GST marketplace rules.

sections.heading: Sharing
sections.body: We share data with payment processors, our property management / booking systems, and service partners (e.g. cleaners) only as needed to deliver the stay.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may request access to or correction of your personal information by emailing admin@gbholidayhomes.co.nz.
